llm_fields.description: The scheme provides financial assistance to SC/ST students to pursue undergraduate, postgraduate and PhD programmes overseas across a wide range of fields, with scholarship amounts varying from 33% to 100% based on family income.
llm_fields.eligibility: Applicants must be permanent residents of Karnataka with a valid passport, be aged 21 or younger for undergraduate courses or 35 or younger for postgraduate and PhD courses, have at least 80% marks in PUC/12th (undergraduate) or 55% in the qualifying degree (postgraduate/PhD), have cleared GRE/GMAT/TOEFL/IELTS, secured admission to a full‑time overseas degree programme, and meet the scheme’s income‑based criteria.
